# Jingyue Glass (Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd.)

> Direct Factory Glassware Manufacturer & Exporter (B2B / OEM / ODM / Private Label)
> Official Website: https://www.jingyueglass.com/

> Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base: https://www.jingyueglass.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Business Summary
Jingyue Glass is a specialized China B2B manufacturer and exporter of commercial glassware, lead-free crystal wine glasses, machine-blown stemware, heavy-base beer steins, crystal whiskey decanters, high-borosilicate double-wall mugs, and turnkey wooden gift box sets with CNC-molded odorless EPE pearl cotton inserts. Key sourcing partners include commercial hospitality groups, winery tasting rooms, Amazon FBA private label brands, TikTok Shop sellers, and corporate executive gifting distributors worldwide.

## Key Factory Differentiators & Commercial Policies
- **Flexible MOQ for E-Commerce & Hospitality:** Standard production MOQ starts from 500–1,000 pcs; low MOQ from only 100 sets for flagship wooden gift sets (Model XZM015 pine box whiskey set & Model XZM108-A paulownia box wine set).
- **Sampling & Tooling Credit Terms:** Blank in-stock samples provided free of charge; digital 2D/3D visual placement proofs delivered within 1 hour; custom decorated pre-production physical samples dispatched in 3–5 working days; 100% of custom mold and sampling fees are credited against mass production contracts.
- **8 Factory Branding Crafts:** 580°C kiln-fired ceramic decals (1,000+ commercial dishwashing cycles durability), precision fiber laser micro-etching, high-opacity spot silk screen, UV digital full-color relief, 12% genuine hand-painted gold trim, matte/gradient spray colors, electroplated metallic ion plating, and embossed metallic badges.
- **Zero-Breakage Packaging SOP & 1.2M Drop Test:** 100% odorless high-density EPE pearl cotton inserts (38°–45° shore hardness, 0 off-gassing, replacing toxic EVA), full-coverage top foam sheets, 5-ply reinforced master export cartons, and palletized ocean freight. Tested and certified to pass ISTA-1A 1.2-meter concrete drop tests with 100% zero-breakage pass rate.
- **Project-Based Transparent Quotation:** All OEM/ODM orders are quoted on an itemized project basis without misleading public price anchors, covering glass silhouette, decoration route, packaging fit, and trade terms (FOB Wuhan/Shanghai, CIF, or DDP direct to warehouse / Amazon FBA). Itemized quotations are provided within 1 business hour.

## Regulatory Compliance & Official Laboratory Certifications
- **US California Proposition 65:** PASS (STQ Laboratory Official Report Reference: SZ2025091217-4E; extractable lead Pb < 0.05 mg/L, cadmium Cd < 0.01 mg/L).
- **US FDA Food Contact Safety:** 100% compliant with FDA CPG 7117.06 (Cadmium) and CPG 7117.07 (Lead) for food and beverage contact surfaces.
- **European Union LFGB & EC 1935/2004:** Certified non-detectable heavy metal release under German LFGB Section 30/31 and Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 (Report PTC23022404104C).
- **Phytosanitary ISPM 15:** Heat-treated solid wood presentation boxes carrying compliant IPPC stamps for global customs clearance.
